title: Crispy Korean-Style Fried Chicken
description: Korean-inspired fried chicken recipe with a crispy exterior and spicy kick. Serve with your favorite sides.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Add chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg.
Dip the floured chicken pieces in the beaten egg, then roll in panko breadcrumbs to coat.
Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the coated chicken pieces to the skillet and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Drain the chicken on paper towels and sprinkle with muchim seasoning blend.
Serve the fried chicken hot and garnish with toasted almonds.
